-- Module:WorldEventData
-- The daily events and the game time events for Template:WorldEventTimetable and Template:WorldNext.
-- Edit this page when an event changes, every table and every "next event" card updates from it.
--
-- All real world times are SERVER TIME, America/New_York (daylight saving follows the game). The page converts them
-- to the reader's time zone with the script in MediaWiki:Common.js.
--
-- events: name, icon (File: name), cls (colour, see Template:WorldEventTimetable/styles.css), duration in minutes,
--         panel = true: gets its own card (up for duration minutes, then gone until the next time), not in the day columns
--         parts (the names shown and the page each links to. A name only becomes a link when that page exists,
--         so there are never red links. A third value true always links, even before the page exists)
-- daily:  { event, day, time }  day is Daily (every day) or Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
-- gametime: { event, hour }     events that happen when the in-game clock reaches an hour. The game clock runs 6 times
--         faster than real time, so each one happens every 4 real hours. The clock is kept right by the sync bot on
--         Module:GameTimeData (see /gametime in Discord).
return {
	server = 'America/New_York',

	-- the pages the "next" cards link to
	listPage = 'World Events',
	bossPage = 'World Bosses',

	events = {
		-- daily events
		mist   = { name = 'Mistmerrow', icon = 'Event_Mistmerrow.png', cls = 'mist', duration = 25,
			parts = { { 'Mistmerrow', 'Mistmerrow' } } },
		halcy  = { name = 'Halcyona', icon = 'Event_Halcyona.png', cls = 'halcy', duration = 60,
			parts = { { 'Halcyona', 'Halcyona' } } },
		luscas = { name = 'Luscas', icon = 'Event_Luscas.png', cls = 'luscas', duration = 60,
			parts = { { 'Luscas', 'Luscas' } } },
		gold   = { name = 'Freedich Gold Trader', icon = 'Event_Gold_Trader.png', cls = 'gold', duration = 120, panel = true,
			parts = { { 'Freedich Gold Trader', 'Freedich Gold Trader' } } },
		dgs    = { name = 'Delphinad Ghost Ship', icon = 'Event_Delphinad_Ghost_Ship.png', cls = 'dgs', duration = 720,
			parts = { { 'Delphinad Ghost Ship', 'Delphinad Ghost Ship' } } },
		veroe  = { name = 'Veroe Harvest Festival', icon = 'Event_Veroe_Harvest_Festival.png', cls = 'veroe', duration = 60,
			parts = { { 'Veroe Harvest Festival', 'Veroe Harvest Festival' } } },
		abyss  = { name = 'Abyssal Attack', icon = 'Event_Abyssal_Attack.png', cls = 'abyss', duration = 90,
			parts = { { 'Abyssal Attack', 'Abyssal Attack' } } },
		sushi  = { name = 'Supplying the Settlers', icon = 'Event_Supplying_the_Settlers.png', cls = 'sushi', duration = 120,
			parts = { { 'Supplying the Settlers', 'Supplying the Settlers' } } },
		-- game time events
		gr     = { name = 'Grimghast Rift', icon = 'Event_Grimghast_Rift.png', cls = 'gr',
			parts = { { 'Grimghast Rift', 'Grimghast Rift' } } },
		jmg    = { name = 'Jola/Meina/Glenn', icon = 'Event_Jola_Meina_Glenn.png', cls = 'jmg',
			parts = { { 'Jola', 'Jola' }, { 'Meina', 'Meina' }, { 'Glenn', 'Glenn' } } },
		cr     = { name = 'Crimson Rift', icon = 'Event_Crimson_Rift.png', cls = 'cr',
			parts = { { 'Crimson Rift', 'Crimson Rift' } } },
		sun    = { name = 'Sungold Crimson Rift', icon = 'Event_Crimson_Rift.png', cls = 'sun',
			parts = { { 'Sungold Crimson Rift', 'Sungold Crimson Rift' } } },
		hasla  = { name = 'Hasla Rift', icon = 'Event_Hasla_Rift.png', cls = 'hasla',
			parts = { { 'Hasla Rift', 'Hasla Rift' } } },
	},

	-- server time (New York)
	daily = {
		{ 'mist', 'Daily', '10:00' }, { 'mist', 'Daily', '15:00' }, { 'mist', 'Daily', '21:00' },
		{ 'halcy', 'Daily', '04:30' }, { 'halcy', 'Daily', '12:30' }, { 'halcy', 'Daily', '22:00' },
		{ 'luscas', 'Daily', '14:00' }, { 'luscas', 'Daily', '20:00' },
		-- the Gold Trader is up 2 hours, then gone 2 hours, on repeat. Its own card, not in the day columns
		{ 'gold', 'Daily', '00:30' }, { 'gold', 'Daily', '04:30' }, { 'gold', 'Daily', '08:30' },
		{ 'gold', 'Daily', '12:30' }, { 'gold', 'Daily', '16:30' }, { 'gold', 'Daily', '20:30' },
		{ 'dgs', 'Daily', '14:15' },
		{ 'veroe', 'Tue', '15:30' }, { 'veroe', 'Tue', '19:30' },
		{ 'veroe', 'Thu', '15:30' }, { 'veroe', 'Thu', '19:30' },
		{ 'veroe', 'Sat', '15:30' }, { 'veroe', 'Sat', '19:30' },
		{ 'abyss', 'Tue', '20:00' }, { 'abyss', 'Thu', '20:00' }, { 'abyss', 'Sat', '16:00' },
		{ 'sushi', 'Mon', '14:30' }, { 'sushi', 'Mon', '22:00' },
		{ 'sushi', 'Wed', '14:30' }, { 'sushi', 'Wed', '22:00' },
		{ 'sushi', 'Sun', '14:30' }, { 'sushi', 'Sun', '22:00' },
	},

	-- in-game hour (0-23)
	gametime = {
		{ 'gr', 0 }, { 'jmg', 6 }, { 'cr', 12 }, { 'sun', 18 }, { 'hasla', 18 },
	},
}
